basic_info.headline: Staff Engineer • Software Architect • Full-Stack Engineer • Java • REST APIs • TypeScript • AI Agents • RAG • LLMs
basic_info.about:
Senior software architect and full-stack engineer with deep experience leading product modernization across enterprise platforms, including Java, TypeScript, APIs, cloud-native services, modern web UIs, mobile applications, and AI-enabled systems.

Experience highlights:
 - 20+ years in enterprise software development across backend services, APIs, frontend applications, and product modernization  
 - 10+ years in Java development, including enterprise API and backend service development with Spring, Spring Boot, and Helidon MP 
 - 10+ years in frontend and UI development across frameworks including Preact/React, Oracle JET, ADF/JSF, and Struts
 - Recent experience building AI-enabled systems using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, vector search, embeddings, and prompt orchestration
 - Established AI-first development patterns and prompt libraries that drove 2-3x productivity gains across the team

At Oracle, I led architecture and delivery across UI, backend, mobile, UX, and AI initiatives. Recent work included modernizing a network operations platform, creating a Preact-based UI architecture, establishing AI-first development patterns, and building an AI assistant for natural-language access to operational data.

My background spans software architecture, full-stack development, API design, UX, and technical leadership. I am strongest in roles that combine hands-on engineering, system design, product modernization, and AI-enabled product development.

Core areas: Software Architecture, Full-Stack Engineering, Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, TypeScript, Microservices, Preact/React, AI Agents, LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, UX, and Product Modernization.

experience.title: Senior Principal Member of Technical Staff
experience.description:
Led software architecture, full-stack engineering, and product modernization across Oracle platforms spanning Java and TypeScript applications, REST APIs, microservices, cloud-native services, mobile, UX, AI-native development, and AI agentic systems.

Unified Assurance – Network Operations Platform
Appointed as AI Champion to define technical direction and drive adoption of AI-enabled development and user experiences.
Created a modern Preact-based UI architecture for legacy platform modernization.
Established AI-first development patterns and prompt libraries that drove 2–3x UI modernization productivity.

AI Agent for Network Operations
Architected and implemented an AI agent that enabled natural-language access to network health and operational data.
Built the retrieval and orchestration stack using RAG, vector search, embeddings, and prompt orchestration.

Public Safety Suite – 911 Dispatch
Led feature design and delivery for a critical executive-level demo across UI, API, GIS, and database layers.
Delivered full-stack features supporting high-stakes dispatch workflows.

Mobile Platform
Re-architected authentication from embedded web login to native Android UI.
Designed consumer-driven REST APIs that reduced unnecessary calls and payload size.
Improved observability and startup responsiveness through tracing, logging, metrics, and performance improvements.

UX Design
Served on a three-member UX team supporting applications across the Communications Business Unit.
Partnered with product managers to design a responsive self-service buying experience across desktop and mobile.
Created Axure prototypes, click-through mockups, and HTML/CSS assets for development teams.
